subject: MAP kickoff — scope & owner confirmation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Torres <maya.torres@aperturelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — scope & owner confirmation

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Per our conversation I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align on success criteria, owners, and a realistic timeline for Aperture's 30-day evaluation of Redwood Inference. High level ask: confirm the champ + technical lead, the top 2 evaluation goals, and any hard procurement or security milestones that would affect the timeline.

Proposed starter items (feel free to edit):
- Evaluation window: 30 days from pilot start (target pilot start: Jan 4, 2027)
- Primary success criteria: 1) 95th-pct latency under 250ms for the generation workload; 2) end-to-end cost target <= $0.007/token equivalent; 3) model answer accuracy on the 50-case test set >= 88%.
- Owners: Aperture champion = Maya Torres (business); tech lead = Samuel Reed (engineering).
- Redwood owners: AE = Rishi Malhotra; CS onboarding = Marissa Cole.
- Procurement target: contract signature by Jan 28 to stay on our Q1 onboarding cadence.

I've attached a one-page MAP template to make it easy to iterate and will drop a draft after you confirm owners. Can you reply with any adjustments and an initial list of stakeholders who should be on the kickoff?

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Aperture_MAP_template_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

From: Maya Torres <maya.torres@aperturelabs.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dr. Samuel Reed <sam.reed@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — scope & owner confirmation

Thanks Rishi — this is perfect and aligns with how we like to run pilots. Quick notes:

- Confirming owners: I will be the business champion (Maya Torres). Sam (cc'd) will be the tech lead.
- Additional stakeholders to include: Diego Alvarez (AI infra lead) and our procurement mailbox (procurement@aperturelabs.com) for contract timing/terms.
- Timeline tweak: procurement likely needs an additional week for internal review — target signature Feb 4, 2027. Does that still fit your Q1 onboarding expectations?
- Goals: we'll add a 4th criterion — integration ease: ability to call the Redwood API from our staging cluster with tokenized logs into our KMS within 2 days of onboarding.

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for next week once you share candidate times. Attaching a short stakeholder roster (PDF) for your reference.

Cheers,
Maya
Director, Product Strategy | Aperture Labs
maya.torres@aperturelabs.com

Attachment: Aperture_stakeholder_roster.pdf (pdf, 18KB)
